verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents streaming that updates applications in real time when features are changed or toggled. It is limited to JavaScript and React and is described in the GrowthBook Proxy docs. A toggle endpoint can switch flags on or off per environment, which supports kill-switch use. missing for 10: streaming or fast-polling coverage for the other SDKs, documented propagation latency (seconds), evidence of streaming outside the Proxy setup, and hands-on corroboration that a kill switch reaches connected SDKs quickly.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills

citations.quote: Updates your application in real-time as features are changed or toggled in GrowthBook (JavaScript and React only)
